topics.title: Custody Dispute and Promotional Chaos
topics.summary: A comedian recounts a chaotic conversation between two parents embroiled in a custody dispute. They repeatedly argue about promotional opportunities for the comedian’s career while discussing past therapy sessions and legal challenges, ultimately devolving into an unproductive exchange highlighting misunderstandings regarding professional boundaries and media appearances.

topics.title: Stern vs. Snyder Showdown
topics.summary: During a heated exchange on air, Howard Stern criticized former NBC Today host David Snyder’s interview style and accused him of attempting to damage Stern's reputation by walking out during an interview. Snyder responded with accusations that Stern was trying to sabotage his television career, leading to personal attacks regarding their broadcasting approaches.

topics.title: Rodney King Beatings and Police Chief Gates' Statements
topics.summary: During the broadcast, discussion centered on police chief Darryl Gates’ statements following the Rodney King beating, including his refusal to step down and controversial remarks about Mr. King’s future prospects. The conversation also included concerns regarding past comments from Gates concerning casual drug use and racially charged opinions expressed in 1978 and 1982, alongside a separate incident involving a deaf boy who was allegedly beaten by police.

topics.title: Polish Politician and Soviet Plane Shootdown
topics.summary: A phone call discusses a Polish politician advocating for freedom of speech while referencing military action against a Soviet plane in the Middle East. The conversation then shifts to Michael Jackson's massive entertainment contract, followed by an absurd discussion about hiring a barbershop quartet and offering roles on a sitcom to Max Alexander and Mindy Cohen.

topics.title: Mayor Koch and Rat Complaints
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss escalating complaints about rats in the city following recent events involving Mayor Koch. An unknown caller named Max claims he’s been offered a sitcom role by Carson Productions, detailing bizarre interactions and speculating on his potential success or failure while discussing President Bush's canceled wake-up calls.

topics.title: Donahue Call & Louis Anderson Controversy
topics.summary: During a Donahue segment, Howard Stern discusses his interaction with comedian Louis Anderson and the latter’s personal material about his alcoholic father. The conversation quickly devolved into critiques of Anderson's comedic themes, culminating in an attempt to plug 7-Eleven while exploring broader issues regarding creative expression and public perception.
